entries.original_title: Paper page - HiSTEVE 1.0: Harnessing Human-Interface VLA Agents for Open-World Games
entries.subtitle: HiSTEVE combines long-term planning with keyboard-and-mouse control in Minecraft, aiming to let agents complete complex tasks through the game's native interface.
entries.reject_reason: The paper credits Tencent, but it does not establish a connection to the tracked Tencent Hunyuan entity.

entries.original_title: AI Video Generation News: Industry Updates and Kling 4.0
entries.subtitle: The report reviews research, production workflows, and transparency trends, and describes how Kling 4.0 supports reference-led creation, stable motion, precise edits, and longer stories.
entries.reject_reason: This retrospective discusses Kling 4.0's earlier launch but is not the launch announcement itself.

entries.original_title: Paper page - On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
entries.subtitle: Models can train themselves with generated questions and reasoning based only on broad topics, improving across several areas without outside supervision.
entries.reject_reason: This self-training paper credits Google researchers but does not identify the tracked Google DeepMind entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - RynnUnify: Towards Unified Embodied Brain
entries.subtitle: RynnUnify is a 16B embodied model that combines visual planning, physical reasoning, and robot control for tasks that require many steps.
entries.reject_reason: RynnUnify is attributed to DAMO Academy, not the tracked Alibaba Qwen entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - RSIHub: A Composable Framework for Agent-Evolution Methods
entries.subtitle: RSIHub offers shared tools and reusable components for building, comparing, and extending agent-evolution methods, while keeping evaluation tied to candidates and conditions.
entries.reject_reason: This tracker-hosted agent framework paper credits ByteDance but does not identify the tracked ByteDance Seed entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Dual Exam: Controlled Evaluation of Multimodal Agents and World Models
entries.subtitle: Dual Exam tests multimodal agents and world models separately across several fields, finding uneven results and no cases where both succeeded in pilot tests.
entries.reject_reason: This independently authored benchmark evaluates tracked models but is not a research result from a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - UserArena: Benchmarking Interactive User Simulation for Long-Horizon Shopping Agents
entries.subtitle: UserArena provides 64,729 shopping session trajectories from 11,010 users, covering 566,102 items and 13 action types, for interactive agent testing and evaluation.
entries.reject_reason: This tracker-hosted paper describes shopping-agent research, not research from a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Omni-Woodpecker: Hallucination Correction via Evidence-Prior Rebalancing for Omni LLMs
entries.subtitle: Omni-Woodpecker is a training-free method that finds conflicts between input types and adjusts model representations to reduce misleading cross-modal answers.
entries.reject_reason: This independently authored paper uses a Qwen model as a benchmark backbone but is not Qwen research.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Every Weight Is a Path of Shared Discrete Decisions
entries.subtitle: TWIG represents neural-network weights as shared paths of discrete choices, linking compression methods and supporting efficient circuits for fixed weights.
entries.reject_reason: This tracker-hosted weight-compression paper is attributed to researchers outside the tracked entities.

entries.original_title: Paper page - TenetBench: A Clause-Anchored Russian Corpus for Evaluating Language Models against Professional Codes of Ethics
entries.subtitle: TenetBench checks whether language models follow professional ethics codes by comparing conflicting requests with harmless versions, and finds frequent unflagged violations across most tested models.
entries.reject_reason: This tracker-hosted ethics benchmark is not attributed to a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - DraMaze: A Multi-Agent Pipeline with Future-Aware Memory for Diverse Microdrama Script Generation
entries.subtitle: DraMaze uses multi-agent search, trope memory, and narrative dependency trees to improve microdrama plot variety and coherence, with MiDramaBench for evaluation.
entries.reject_reason: This tracker-hosted script-generation paper is not attributed to a tracked entity.
